text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Well, I was supposed to cook for

everyone today...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
But I ended up burning everything... And
they
were all so excited for my food
too...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She must be seriously exhausted to have
made
such a huge cooking blunder. I
should look into
adjusting her race
schedule.
